en.headline: Lee says Hong Kong can mobilise multi-currency capital for green projects
en.dek: At the first Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference held in the city, the Chief Executive announced a green technology bridgehead plan and a supercharging demonstration station for next year.
body: Chief Executive John Lee told the Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference that multilateral cooperation on green transition yields better results than unilateral action by pooling resources, expertise and ideas.

Speaking at the event, the first of its kind held in Hong Kong and co-organised by the Environment and Ecology Bureau and the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Lee described the city as a leading green and sustainable finance centre. He noted that last month the government issued a new batch of digital green bonds denominated in Hong Kong dollars, renminbi, US dollars and euros, showing the ability to mobilise capital across currencies.

He said Hong Kong could, for example, bring together mainland equipment suppliers, Southeast Asian developers and Middle East investors for solar projects, raise funds and manage risks. The government will launch a Green Technology Bridgehead Programme next year to help mainland and overseas green firms take solutions into Belt and Road markets and to let those markets use Hong Kong as a springboard for overseas expansion.

Lee added that the government is working with the National Energy Administration on Hong Kong’s first supercharging technology demonstration station, targeted for completion next year, to showcase equipment compatible with both national and European standards. More than 400 officials and experts from 16 countries and regions are attending the conference, themed around green transition with Global South partners.

zh.headline: 李家超：香港可跨貨幣動員資本支持綠色發展
zh.dek: 一帶一路綠色創新大會首度在港舉行，行政長官宣布明年推出綠色科技橋頭堡計劃及超級充電技術示範站。
body: 行政長官李家超在一帶一路綠色創新大會上表示，綠色轉型需要各方共同努力，透過匯聚資源、專業知識和創新理念，多邊合作可以比單邊行動取得更大成效。
今屆大會由環境及生態局與國家生態環境部合辦，是首次在香港舉行。李家超指香港是領先的綠色及可持續金融中心，上月政府發行以港元、人民幣、美元和歐元計價的數碼綠色債券，顯示有能力跨貨幣動員資本。
他舉例說，香港可為太陽能項目匯聚內地設備供應商、東南亞開發商和中東投資者，並安排融資及風險管理。特區政府明年將推出「綠色科技橋頭堡計劃」，協助內地及海外綠色企業把方案帶入一帶一路市場，同時讓當地企業以香港為跳板拓展海外。
李家超又稱，正與國家能源局合作建立香港首個「超級充電技術示範站」，目標明年建成，展示兼容國家及歐洲充電標準的技術。大會以「攜手南方綠色轉型，共促全球可持續發展」為主題，吸引來自16個國家及地區逾400名官員及專家出席。
